newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: CRICKET - Zahid wrecks NZ to square cricket series.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET - Zahid wrecks NZ to square cricket series.

text.p: Pakistan paceman Mohammed Zahid destroyed New Zealand with a seven-wicket haul to complete a remarkable debut and square the series in the second and final test on Sunday.

His seven for 66 coupled with his first innings four for 64 made him the first Pakistan bowler to capture more than 10 wickets on his debut. Pakistan won by an innings and 13 runs with a day and a half to spare.
Resuming their second innings at 69 without loss, still 112 behind, New Zealand openers Bryan Young and Justin Vaughan added 13 before Zahid struck, trapping Vaughan lbw for 27.

It was purely a foretaste. Zahid proceded to grab the next four wickets in quick succession as New Zealand slumped to 119 for five with all hope of salvation gone. Young, who topped scored with 67, was among his early victims.
Zahid, generating considerable pace off the pitch, wrapped up the innings by trapping both Chris Harris (14) and Dipak Patel (0) leg before.
Match referee Cammie Smith said afterwards he had fined Pakistan 10 percent of their match fee because of their slow over rate.
New Zealand won the first test by 44 runs.
